parents.subject: Game Studies and Design
parents.course: Special Topics in Game Studies & Design

ns2:section.sectionText: This course is designed to educate students on how to collaboratively discover and visually deliver-upon ideas in the service of a video game. By semester’s end, students will develop an industry perspective on the why and how of video game concept art. From research and ideation to artistic skills and techniques, participants will learn how to prepare-for and thrive within the role, all via a simulated game development pre-production lifecycle. Students will leave the course with their own visual record of the project's evolutionary pathway; a critical lens through which potential employers will evaluate their skills and ideas.
